channel.title: Crypto Bulletin
channel.description: Crypto Bulletin reports crypto news on bitcoin, ethereum, stablecoins, exchanges, DeFi protocols, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: Binance estimates security incident impact at $6.3 billion
item.description: Binance estimates a security incident affected about $6.3 billion, says roughly $3 billion is frozen and deposits and withdrawals remain suspended during checks.

item.title: Ripple wins final OCC approval for national trust bank
item.description: Ripple received final OCC approval for a national trust bank on Oct. 26, adding federal oversight to RLUSD reserves and custody while issuance stays with its New York entity.

item.title: Dogecoin Labs brings MyDoge, DogeOS and Such App together
item.description: Dogecoin Labs formed with the Dogecoin Foundation, combining MyDoge, DogeOS and Such App to build wallet, application and merchant payment tools around DOGE.

item.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum
item.description: JPMorgan’s JPM Coin is now available to institutional clients on Ethereum, extending the bank’s dollar deposit token beyond Base for onchain transfers.

item.title: HSBC launches RedCoin stablecoin on PayMe in Hong Kong
item.description: HSBC launched its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin on PayMe on 23 October, with wallet access rolling out to more than 3.3 million users for transfers and merchant payments.

item.title: Aviva tokenizes £22B sterling fund share class on XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva Investors and Ripple launched a tokenized share class for Aviva’s £22 billion Sterling Liquidity Fund on XRP Ledger, with Aviva investing £50 million.

item.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum
item.description: JPMorgan brought JPM Coin to Ethereum on Oct. 19, giving institutional clients another public network for moving dollar deposits onchain.

item.title: Electrum patched Bitcoin fee-bump flaw after reported theft
item.description: Electrum says malicious servers exploited versions before 4.8.3, redirecting fee-bump payments; one user reported losing bitcoin before the Oct. 24 patch.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms transaction finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing its 2020 consensus system with a 150-millisecond finality target that could speed payments and exchange deposits.

item.title: Super League shareholders approve proposals for Metaplanet’s 2,100 BTC deal
item.description: Super League shareholders approved proposals tied to Metaplanet’s planned 2,100-Bitcoin and $2.5 million investment, moving the deal toward a fourth-quarter close.

item.title: OCC rule leaves crypto platforms free to offer stablecoin rewards
item.description: The OCC's GENIUS Act rule leaves crypto platforms able to pass stablecoin reserve earnings to customers, while keeping issuers barred from paying holders directly.

item.title: OCC leaves exchange stablecoin rewards to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC finalized its GENIUS Act rule on Oct. 21, leaving exchange-paid stablecoin rewards subject to case-by-case review while barring issuers from paying yield directly.

item.title: How zerofi’s wrapped assets fit into DeFi
item.description: ZeroFi’s wrapped assets make deposits usable in DeFi on another chain, but their value depends on backing, redemption and the bridge that connects them.

item.title: New York seeks $1.37bn from NovaTech founders
item.description: New York is asking a court to order Cynthia and Eddy Petion to pay $1.37 billion over NovaTech, after a default judgment found them liable in 2025.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms transaction finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT and targeting 150-millisecond finality, a change that could speed settlement and free block space.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms transaction finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing its old consensus system with a 150-millisecond finality target while keeping wallets, apps and fees unchanged.

item.title: How Much Crypto Reaches the Other Chain?
item.description: The amount that arrives depends on network fees, swap pricing and destination costs; compare the quoted output with the amount sent before approving a cross-chain transfer.

item.title: How to avoid a failed transfer to Manta Pacific
item.description: Most failed Manta Pacific transfers come from the wrong source chain, missing native gas, or an unfinished claim step — check these before you bridge.

item.title: How to Reconcile Recurring Cross-Chain Treasury Transfers
item.description: Match each transfer’s source and destination records, fees and status to one treasury entry so recurring movements stay auditable across chains.

item.title: Byreal perpetuals: set a stop loss before opening a trade
item.description: Byreal lets traders attach take-profit and stop-loss levels to perpetual orders; choose the market, set direction and size, then check the trigger and margin.
